tasks.label: Test Experiential gpt-6-astra
args: $envFile = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.env.local' | Where-Object { $_ -match '^([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$' }; foreach ($line in $envFile) { $match = [regex]::Match($line, '^([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$'); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($match.Groups[1].Value.Trim(), $match.Groups[2].Value.Trim()) }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:EXPLABS_API_KEY)) { throw 'EXPLABS_API_KEY is not set in .env.local' }; $body = @{ model = 'gpt-6-astra'; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'Reply with exactly: Experiential gateway test passed.' }); stream = $false } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.experientiallabs.ai/v1/chat/completions' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:EXPLABS_API_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Body $body; [ordered]@{ reply = $response.choices[0].message.content; usage = $response.usage } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
